jobs.name: Repo Checks
jobs.run: pnpm --filter @flyt/ui test:tokens && pnpm --filter @flyt/ui test:components && python3 scripts/check_test_names.py --range "$LOCAL_CI_BASE_SHA...$LOCAL_CI_HEAD_SHA" --scope backend && python3 scripts/check_test_names.py --range "$LOCAL_CI_BASE_SHA...$LOCAL_CI_HEAD_SHA" --scope frontend && python3 scripts/test_quality_checkers.py && uv run scripts/test_extension_release.py && python3 scripts/check_conventions.py --range "$LOCAL_CI_BASE_SHA...$LOCAL_CI_HEAD_SHA" && python3 scripts/check_design_system_escapes.py --base "$LOCAL_CI_BASE_SHA" && python3 scripts/check_react_doctor.py && node scripts/check_typography_semantics.mjs

jobs.name: Backend
jobs.run: (cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy --config-file pyproject.toml) && ./scripts/check_migration_drift.sh && (cd backend && uv run pytest -q --cov=flyt --cov-report=term --cov-config=.coveragerc)

jobs.name: Frontend & Extension
jobs.run: (cd frontend && pnpm api:types:check) && pnpm lint && (cd frontend && pnpm type-check && pnpm format:check && pnpm format:check:packages && pnpm build) && (cd frontend && pnpm test && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 pnpm test:storybook) && (cd extension && pnpm test) && pnpm --filter @flyt/extension lint && pnpm --filter @flyt/extension type-check && pnpm --filter @flyt/extension build && pnpm --filter @flyt/extension build:firefox && pnpm --filter @flyt/extension lint:firefox

jobs.name: Services
jobs.run: cd morph-svc && uv run --no-project --with 'ruff==0.17.2' ruff check . && uv run --no-project --with 'ruff==0.17.2' ruff format --check . && uv run --no-project --with 'mypy==2.4.0' python -m mypy . && uv run --no-project --with 'pytest>=8.0.0' python -m pytest -q

skip.name: Security Scan (Trivy)
skip.reason: container/dep scan needs the Trivy action + registry access
